standard_prerequisites.name: Localisation of a tensor-triangulated category at a Serre tensor ideal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same source, the notation AB = mT/Loc(cB) set up before the statement; used at lines 797-806
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the quotient category and the localisation functor Q_cB through which the homological functor factors.

core_obligations: Establish that the functor H = Q_cC o hat F o yoneda_T is homological and apply the homological-functor criterion to it, so that cB = Ker(hat H) cap A^fp is a maximal Serre tensor ideal of A^fp (proof lines 795-799).

Factor hat H through Q_cB, obtaining a unique tensor-exact coproduct-preserving functor bar F : mT/Loc(cB) -> mS/Loc(cC) making the square commute, and take its right adjoint bar U by Grothendieck-category theory (proof lines 799-809).
Compare the two right adjoints of bar F o Q_cB = Q_cC o hat F to get the isomorphism R_cB o bar U = hat U o R_cC, and use it to identify R_cB(bar U(bEC)) with yoneda_T(U(EC)) (proof lines 809-813).

Conclude that bar U(bEC) is the image in AB of U(EC), that its unit is a monomorphism, hence that the injective hull bEB of the unit is a direct summand of bar U(bEC), and that this decomposition descends to cT (proof lines 813-814).
proof_roadmap: Apply the homological-functor criterion to H to produce the Serre tensor ideal cB and the factorisation of hat H through the localisation (proof lines 795-799).
Build bar F and its right adjoint bar U, compare right adjoints to identify R_cB bar U with hat U R_cC, and read the injective-hull decomposition off that comparison (proof lines 799-814).
difficulty_reason: The lemma works with a big tensor-triangulated category mT satisfying the standing hypothesis and a Serre tensor ideal cC, and claims that the full subcategory cB of objects whose image under hat F lies in cC is a maximal Serre tensor ideal, that a four-square diagram of localisations and adjoints commutes in the four stated ways, and that the pure-injective object EB is a direct summand of U(EC) (statement lines 765-785). The proof applies the homological-functor criterion to the composite H = Q_cC o hat F o yoneda_T, factors it through the localisation at cB, and then compares the two right adjoints of the same functor to obtain R_cB o bar U = hat U o R_cC (proof lines 795-813). The step that carries the content is that comparison of right adjoints: it is what transfers the injective-hull decomposition from the localised category AB to the original category cT, and the author explicitly notes that the decomposition already holds in cT by a cited clause. The argument uses Grothendieck-category theory in the form of a right-adjoint existence statement rather than a computation. H2.
